section: Driver profile > Comparison to Michael Schumacher

entities.name: Sebastian Vettel
entities.description: Vettel's unexpected win at the 2008 Italian Grand Prix led the media to dub him the 'Baby Schumi'. He played down the comparison stating he wanted to be the 'New Vettel'.

entities.name: Michael Schumacher
entities.description: Schumacher's father is a bricklayer and he had his first taste of racing at the Kerpen karting track near Cologne.
The year of Vettel's unexpected win at the Italian Grand Prix.

entities.description: The race where Vettel had his unexpected win in 2008.

entities.name: Nürburgring
entities.description: A racing venue near Cologne where both Vettel and Schumacher had their early racing experiences.
